_comment: L3 LLM-judge config (E1c). noSelfGrading is the load-bearing property: the judge model/config is INDEPENDENT of the agent-under-test (a self-grading judge = the theater rocket's brain condemns, P29). The canonical noSelfGrading:true flag lives in dsip.json (the DSIP contract); this config wires the judge to the L3 golden task(s) + its rubric. The Claude half is DEFERRED (D8) — the judge lights when CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is set; the deterministic eval (L1/L2) runs at $0 without it.

calibration.size: 50-100 hand-labeled rows (RQ11) — seeded; expand from production failures (the gate is the evolving dataset, HOUSE LAW 2)
calibration.agreementMetric: Cohen's kappa >= 0.6 vs the human labels

tasks.deferred: Claude half (D8) — set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN to score
